name: Hermes Agent (Nous Research)
disclaimer: Written from the documented interface, not verified against an install. Flags drift; correct and open a PR.
notes: -z prints only the final answer. -p is --profile, not a prompt, and -q alone on a terminal opens an interactive session. A single-query session refuses dangerous commands by default (approvals.single_query_mode: deny).

resume.note: resuming under -z is not documented; chat --resume takes an id, a title or latest

options.trust_none_note: the safe toolset has web search, vision and image generation, and no file writing, terminal or code execution
options.effort_why: chat has no flag; agent.reasoning_effort in the configuration

transcript.access: READ-ONLY. A second writer corrupts the agent's own state.
transcript.todo: map the schema against an install

directives.note: only the first match loads, plus a global SOUL.md; --ignore-rules loads none
